svg.title: Example: Backlog Refinement
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape backlog refinement board: session goal, a six-step flow (order, understand, split, examples, size, ready) linked to the toolkit, an items-refined table, and a Definition of Ready check.
svg.text: Get the next few items ordered, understood, split, sized and ready, in one focused session.
Run Events · Backlog Refinement · Order → Understand → Split → Example → Size → Ready
REFINE JUST ENOUGH, JUST IN TIME
FOR EACH ITEM, IN ORDER · STOP WHEN IT'S READY
Who is it for, and why?
Can we finish it in a few
Who it's for and why is clear
Small enough to finish in a few days
No open question that would stop work
“Which items do we need ready for the next iteration?”
“What don't we know yet that would stop us starting?”
Run Events · Inspect & Adapt · Short, Regular, Purposeful
